data.name: Events.Who.Contactor
data.comment: Who did an update on its own.

data.name: Events.Who.Board
data.comment: An event the board itself is the subject of, with one board.

data.name: Events.Who.RunOn
data.comment: In bold before Events.Group.RunOnStart.

data.name: Events.Who.RunOnDone
data.comment: In bold before Events.Group.RunOnEnd.

data.name: Events.Who.SafetyShutOff
data.comment: In bold before Events.Group.Trip, in red.

data.name: Events.Who.TheGroup
data.comment: In bold before Events.Group.StartFailed.

data.name: Events.TheGroup
data.comment: A group that is gone, in place of its name.

data.name: Events.TheRelay
data.comment: A relay that is gone, in place of its name.

data.name: Events.Short.Schedule
data.comment: Who turned a relay off, in its status line: "Off since 12:15 · schedule".

data.name: Events.Update.Requested
data.comment: In every event text, {0} is who did it, shown in bold: a person's name, or e.g. "Schedule".

data.name: Events.Update.WentBack
data.value: {0} went back to {1}: the update to {2} didn't work

data.name: Events.Update.Current
data.value: {0} found nothing newer than {1} to download

data.name: Events.Update.Cancelled
data.value: {0} didn't update to {1}: the update was cancelled

data.name: Events.Update.Switching
data.value: {0} didn't update to {1}: the relays were still switching. Nothing was changed

data.name: Events.Update.Failed
data.value: {0} didn't update to {1}: {2}. Nothing was changed
data.comment: {2} is one of Events.Update.Because.

data.name: Events.Update.Because.Signature
data.value: it didn't pass the check that it's ours

data.name: Events.Update.Because.Backup
data.value: the database couldn't be backed up

data.name: Events.Group.OffAfter
data.comment: {1} is a length, e.g. "2 h".

data.name: Events.Group.RunOnStart
data.comment: After Events.Who.RunOn: {1} is the name of a step of the group, e.g. "Fan" or "Fans", {2} a length. Reads right for any name.

data.name: Events.Group.RunOnEnd
data.comment: After Events.Who.RunOnDone: {1} is a step's name.

data.name: Events.Group.Trip
data.comment: After Events.Who.SafetyShutOff: {1} is the steps turned off, {2} the step above that was off. Reads right for any name.

data.name: Events.Group.TripStarted
data.comment: After Events.Who.SafetyShutOff: {1} is the step above, started so it can run on.

data.name: Events.Group.StartFailed
data.comment: After Events.Who.TheGroup: {1} is a step's name.

data.name: Events.Group.Target
data.comment: Under a group's event: the group's name and its steps.

data.name: Events.List.And
data.comment: Between the names of steps turned off together.

data.name: Events.OffAfter
data.comment: {1} is a length, e.g. "2 h".

data.name: Events.Pulse
data.comment: {1} is a length, e.g. "2 s".

data.name: Events.Rename
data.comment: {1} is the old name; the new one is on the line below.

data.name: Events.Schedule.Added
data.comment: {1} is the schedule, e.g. "Mon–Fri 06:30–08:00".

data.name: Events.Board.TimersOff
data.value: {0} had its own timers turned off

data.name: Events.Board.ModesReset
data.value: {0} had its relays set to normal mode, so its inputs don't switch them

data.name: Events.Board.ModesNotReset
data.value: {0} couldn't have its relays set to normal mode, so its inputs may switch them

data.name: Events.Board.RenamedFrom
data.value: {0} renamed the relay board from {1} to {2}

data.name: Events.Board.AddressFrom
data.value: {0} changed the relay board's address from {1} to {2}

data.name: Events.Board.Address
data.value: {0} set the relay board's address to {1}

data.name: Events.Other
data.comment: An event this version has no words for: {1} is its name in the log.

data.name: Events.Input
data.comment: An input's change: {0} is the input's name with a colon, {1} its state, e.g. "Door: Open".

data.name: Events.Unknown
data.comment: A name the event doesn't have.

data.name: Events.TimeUnknown
data.comment: After an input's change the app only noticed later.

data.name: Events.WhyUnknown
data.value: Why is the time unknown for {0}?
data.comment: Read out by screen readers: {0} is the input's name.

data.name: Events.WhyTimeUnknown
data.value: The app had no contact with the board when this input changed, so it only noticed the change at this time. It may have happened any time before.

data.name: Events.Day.Format
data.comment: A .NET date format for a day this year, e.g. "Monday 2 Nov". Not a sentence: change only the order and the parts.

data.name: Events.Day.YearFormat
data.comment: As Events.Day.Format, for a day in another year.
